run_f_gold: run f_gold to count subarrays with all distinct elements in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify subarray distinct element counting
review_f_gold: review f_gold sliding window algorithm for counting subarrays with distinct elements
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a set instead of a list for O(1) lookups
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts total subarrays with all distinct elements using a sliding window
